title: Discrete Diffusion Models are Minimax Optimal Under Sparsity
abstract: arXiv:2610.19020v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Discrete diffusion models have emerged as a leading alternative to autoregressive models for generating text and other categorical data, yet their theoretical foundations remain less developed than those of their continuous counterparts. For continuous diffusion models, a prominent line of theory suggests that these models can adapt to low-dimensional structure in the data, thereby improving statistical efficiency and generalization. In this work, we investigate the discrete analogue of this phenomenon by studying the statistical rates of discrete diffusion models under sparsity assumptions. By analyzing a nonparametric estimator derived from a regularized score-entropy objective, we establish minimax-optimal rates in the sparse regime. The proposed regularization can be viewed as an adaptation of label smoothing techniques introduced for classification, and does not require the knowledge of the sparsity parameter. translated_title: 稀疏条件下的离散扩散模型是极小极大最优的
translated_abstract: 离散扩散模型已成为生成文本及其他类别数据时替代自回归模型的领先方案，但其理论基础的发展仍落后于连续扩散模型。对于连续扩散模型，一条重要的理论路线表明，这些模型能够自适应数据中的低维结构，从而提升统计效率与泛化能力。在本工作中，我们通过研究稀疏性假设下离散扩散模型的统计速率，来探索这一现象在离散情形中的对应。通过分析由正则化得分熵目标导出的非参数估计量，我们在稀疏情形下建立了极小极大最优速率。所提出的正则化方法可以看作是对分类任务中标签平滑技术的一种改进，并且不需要预先知道稀疏性参数。这表明，离散扩散模型……
tldr: 该论文证明了在稀疏性假设下，基于正则化得分熵目标的离散扩散模型能够达到极小极大最优的统计速率，且所用正则化方法无需预知稀疏参数即可实现自适应。
en_tdlr: This paper establishes minimax-optimal statistical rates for discrete diffusion models under sparsity assumptions via a regularized score-entropy estimator that adapts to unknown sparsity without requiring prior knowledge of the sparsity parameter.
